name: Basic NMOS Current Mirror
description: Two-transistor diode-connected reference current mirror. M_REF is diode-connected (gate tied to drain), establishing a gate voltage that M_MIR replicates to copy the reference current. 1:1 ratio. Output resistance limited by channel-length modulation.

Low Leakage.reasoning: Increased channel dimensions minimise drain-source subthreshold leakage and reduce channel-length modulation.

High Precision.reasoning: Long channel suppresses channel-length modulation; wider channels improve matching.

High Speed.reasoning: Minimum length for fastest settling; precision reduced but bandwidth maximised.

default.reasoning: Balanced sizing: adequate precision with reasonable area.

design_intents.reason: Gate tied to drain forces M_REF to operate at the intersection of its I-V curve, converting the reference current IREF into a stable gate-source voltage that is mirrored to M_MIR.
design_intents.tradeoffs: Simple 1:1 topology but output resistance is limited by channel-length modulation. High λ means IOUT varies with VOUT.
references: Razavi - Design of Analog CMOS Integrated Circuits Ch.3
Gray & Meyer - Analysis and Design of Analog ICs

design_intents.decision_template: Mirror transistor M_MIR matched to M_REF (W={w_val}um, L={l_val}um)
design_intents.reason: Identical W and L ensures the transconductance parameter ratio M_MIR/M_REF = 1.0, giving a 1:1 current copy. Any mismatch in W or L directly appears as a DC current error.
design_intents.tradeoffs: Layout must use common-centroid placement to minimise local threshold voltage gradient mismatch.
alternatives: Ratioed W/L for scaled mirror output (N:1 mirror)

sizing_notes.M_REF: Diode-connected reference. Increasing L improves output resistance and matching.
sizing_notes.M_MIR: Mirror transistor. Must be matched to M_REF for 1:1 accuracy. Use same L and W.

kg_nodes.description: Matched transistor paths replicating bias current values.
Transistor gate tied to its drain node to create a bias reference.
Effective channel length variation under VDS fluctuation causing output current error.
